sloka: अथ जीवति नः शत्रुर्वयं च कृतसंयुगाः।ततस्तदभिपत्स्यामो मनसा यत् समीक्षितम् ।। ६.६४.२४ ।।
transliteration: atha jīvati naḥ śatrurvayaṁ ca kṛtasaṁyugāḥ।tatastadabhipatsyāmo manasā yat samīkṣitam ।। 6.64.24 ।।

translations.english: "If our enemy survives in combat, we too will survive and review as we planned and see."
